subject: Pilot boost request — approval needed for additional eval credits and extension
messages:
From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@catalyst.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: additional runtime for Catalyst POC

Grace —

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. The trial is providing strong signals for our internal ML team, but we’re hitting our token limit earlier than expected because we added longer context windows and a second prompt path for evaluation.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a one-time grant of additional evaluation credits and a short extension (1–2 weeks) so we can run a final set of high-cost scenarios? Specifically: an additional 150k tokens and a 7–14 day extension to the pilot window. This is critical for our technical signoff and will feed directly into a buying decision for Q4.

Attached: trial_usage_report.csv (sample usage and scope).

If there’s a preferred process I should follow (forms/POC amendment), let me know. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Ben Turner
Director of Data Science
Catalyst Analytics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request: additional runtime for Catalyst POC

Aditya, Vivek — forwarding Ben’s ask (see below). Catalyst is a strategic mid-market account; they’ve been high-engagement in the PLG flow and this pilot is the first major technical evaluation that could convert to a reserved capacity conversation.

What I’m proposing: we approve up to 200k additional eval tokens and a 1-week extension, conditioned on a short SOW amendment and logging the concession in the deal record. That keeps the customer moving and limits financial exposure. Priyom — if we approve, can you prepare simple amendment language (attachment: Catalyst_SOW_draft.pdf) and capture the concession in SFDC? HubSpot deal id is linked below.

Key points for approval:
- One-time credit: up to 200k tokens (not recurring)
- Extension: +7 days to existing pilot window
- Require SOW amendment + acknowledgement of usage limits
- No discount to list beyond credits; if they move to committed Dedicated within 60 days we can discuss favorable onboarding credits

Appreciate a quick call if needed. They’re targeting a decision by end of July.

Thanks,
Grace O’Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request: additional runtime for Catalyst POC

Thanks for the context, Grace. I agree we should move quickly here — Catalyst has good buy signals and the ask is modest if we cap it and capture it in the deal record.

Recommend: approve up to 150k additional eval tokens and a 7-day extension. Ask Legal to sign off on the SOW amendment language (Priyom, please loop in legal). Also, we should require the customer to acknowledge that any overages beyond the one-time grant will be charged at standard PLG rates.

Operational items for Priyom:
- Draft amendment (use Catalyst_SOW_draft.pdf as starting point)
- Create an entry in SFDC / HubSpot with concession reason and who approved it (Aditya R. / Vivek K.)
- Track usage and flag if they exceed the 150k grant so we can surface to the deal team

If Vivek is comfortable with this, please confirm and we’ll reply to Ben with a definitive yes and next steps.

-Aditya
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request: additional runtime for Catalyst POC

Approve (one-time exception): 150k additional eval tokens + 7-day extension. Conditions:
1) Concession logged in HubSpot/ SFDC with approvals (Aditya + me).
2) Signed SOW amendment or email acknowledgement from the customer accepting the single-use credit and extension terms.
3) No automatic renewal of credits — overages billed at standard PLG rates.

Priyom — please prepare amendment and coordinate with Legal for a quick review. Grace — once you have the acknowledgement, send the formal approval to Ben and include the amended SOW and DocuSign link.

Vivek
CEO (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@catalyst.ai>

Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot request: additional runtime for Catalyst POC

Ben — thanks for the patience. We can approve a one-time grant of 150k additional eval tokens and a 7-day extension to your pilot window. Conditions are the same as discussed: we’ll need a short SOW amendment that you sign acknowledging this is a one-time credit and that any additional usage will be billed at standard PLG rates.

Next steps: I’ve attached the draft amendment (Catalyst_SOW_draft.pdf) and a one-click DocuSign link to sign the acknowledgement: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder-Catalyst-POC-8342. Priyom will log the concession in HubSpot (deal id DEAL-8342) and monitor usage. Please sign the amendment by Tue, Jul 14 so we can provision the credit and extend the pilot window early next week.

If you’d like to talk through technical scope before signing, happy to grab 30 minutes.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
